role: Execute six-step semantic teaching pipeline (assert_fact) to parse guardian statements, classify semantic edge types via PT-10, detect contradictions, and write WordSenseNode edges to the knowledge graph.
detail: SemanticTeachingHandler is the primary executor class that orchestrates the assert_fact pipeline (Steps 1-6). Step 1 validates parse bindings (copular/transitive templates); Step 2 calls PT10PromptExecutor to classify edge type (IS_A, HAS_PROPERTY, CAUSES, etc.) with confidence thresholding (abort if <0.7); Step 3 delegates to SemanticContradictionDetector to check IS_A/CAUSES cycles and property negation conflicts, creating ArbitrationRequest nodes on conflict; Step 4 resolves or creates WordSenseNodes and writes semantic edges with GUARDIAN provenance, full property schema (scope_context_count, session_id, turn_id, pt10_confidence, valid_from/to, guardian_confirmed=False), and composite-key duplicate detection (property_type for HAS_PROPERTY); Step 5 increments scope_context_count via ScopeContextMechanics or legacy same-session+30min-gap check; Step 6 assembles SemanticTeachingResponse for PT-7 consumption. PT10PromptExecutor is a Protocol (Layer 3 boundary) with Layer 4 implementation. Non-fatal failures (event bus, scope mechanics) do not roll back edge writes. Graph writes are atomic -- no partial writes on contradiction.
gotchas: PT10PromptExecutor is Protocol-based; None at init raises no error but Step 2 aborts gracefully. Composite-key duplicate detection includes property_type for HAS_PROPERTY only. Timestamp-based edge IDs (millisecond precision) ensure uniqueness across retracted+re-asserted edges. Scope mechanics delegation is optional (backward-compatible legacy fallback). Non-fatal exception handling on event_bus.publish() and scope_mechanics calls preserves graph consistency but may leave event/metric gaps. datetime import uses __import__ workaround (line 830-832) instead of cleaner import at module level.
